task_definition.title: RBD-α.1a: MassProperties structure_def shell in NEW stdlib/dynamics.ri + stdlib_loader registration
task_definition.description:
Narrowed (R3 split) from prior 3883 scope after two consecutive planning runs hit max_turns. See steward note in details. PRD: docs/prds/v0_3/rigid-body-dynamics.md §4.1 + §10 Phase 1 task α.

SCOPE (this task ONLY — PSD validator + new diagnostic moved to follow-up 3883.b):

1. Create NEW stdlib module `crates/reify-compiler/stdlib/dynamics.ri` with ONLY the `MassProperties` structure_def shell + `constraint mass >= 0`:
   ```
   structure def MassProperties {
       param mass: Mass;
       param com: Point3<Length>;
       param inertia: Matrix<3, 3, Real>;
       param origin: Frame3;
       constraint mass >= 0;
   }
   ```
   Type-name reconciliation per steward addendum:
   - `Tensor3x3` → `Matrix<3, 3, Real>` (precedent: `crates/reify-compiler/stdlib/solver_elastic.ri:308`)
   - bare `Point3` → `Point3<Length>` (precedent: `crates/reify-compiler/stdlib/constitutive.ri:54`)
   - `Frame3` exists as `Type::Frame(3)` in `crates/reify-types/src/ty.rs`; verify .ri surface syntax via reify-syntax.

2. Register in `crates/reify-compiler/src/stdlib_loader.rs` `load_stdlib()` `sources: Vec<(&str, &str)>` table: add `("std.dynamics", include_str!("../stdlib/dynamics.ri"))` AFTER `std.units` and `std.si_units` (dynamics depends on `Mass`/`Length`). Tail position after `std.fdm` is the safe default — no later module references dynamics.

3. Compile-resolution test: a stdlib-loader / type-resolution test that `MassProperties` resolves to its expected structure_def template (model after existing stdlib tests). NO eval-level ctor or PSD test in this task.

CONSTRAINT-BLOCK SYNTAX reference points:
- `crates/reify-compiler/stdlib/tolerancing.ri:30-38` (single inline constraint, cleanest)
- `crates/reify-compiler/stdlib/solver_elastic.ri:167-226` (5 separate constraint lines)
- `crates/reify-compiler/stdlib/solver_buckling.ri:75-96` (3 constraints)
All use inline boolean expressions over param/let bindings — exactly what this task needs.

EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE (covered by follow-up task spawned 2026-05-26):
- E_DynamicsInertiaNotPSD diagnostic variant
- Rust-side eigenvalue PSD validator
- ctor hook at engine_eval.rs:1794
- e2e test `dynamics_ctor_validation_e2e.rs`

User-observable signal (leaf): MassProperties structure_def resolves through stdlib loading; type checking accepts a well-typed MassProperties literal.
